name: MCP Server
description: Lets AI tools use the open project through the Model Context Protocol. One server; every extension brings its own tools.

services.description: How AI tools change a project: undoable, and refused while anything is unsaved.

mcp.enabled.description: Serve the MCP tools to AI clients on this computer. Clients start `w3proj mcp`, which connects to this app.

mcp.projectTools.description: Also offer tools from the open project's own extensions (.w3proj/extensions). A map you got from someone else could bring any tool.

mcp.writeTools.description: Also offer tools that change the project. Each change can be undone, and none is made while something is unsaved.

mcp.saveTool.description: Also let AI tools save everything unsaved in the editors, your own work included. Off, they ask you to save.

mcp.ignoreUndoSteps.description: Tell AI tools not to plan around undo steps. Undo still works; they just stop grouping their work for it.

mcp.confirmTileset.description: Ask in Studio before an AI tool changes the map's tileset. Off, it just happens, after a checkpoint.

mcp.confirmResize.description: Ask in Studio before an AI tool resizes the map. Off, it just happens, after a checkpoint.

mcpTools.name: read_guide
mcpTools.description: Explains how to do a kind of job well, with rules and numbers the other tools can't give. Without a topic it lists them. Read terrain before shaping or decorating any map, melee before building or judging a melee map, and spells before scripting an ability.

mcpTools.name: list_edits
mcpTools.description: The AI edits made to this project since it was opened, oldest first.

mcpTools.name: undo_last_edit
mcpTools.description: Takes back the newest AI edit, unless its files changed since. Can be repeated. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools.

mcpTools.name: edit_text_file
mcpTools.description: Replaces one exact piece of a text file under map/, such as war3map.wts. The piece must occur exactly once. Prefer the specific tools: map/war3map.j is rebuilt from triggers and objects, so changes to it can be lost, and for the ground use paint_terrain and sculpt_terrain. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

find.description: The text to replace, with enough around it to be unique.

mcpTools.name: project_info
mcpTools.description: What W3Proj Studio has open now: the project, the file in the editor, what's unsaved, and what you may do. Reading tools see the last save, and edits are refused while anything is unsaved, so check this when a thing seems missing.

mcpTools.name: studio_status
mcpTools.description: Whether W3Proj Studio is reachable, and what it has open. If this is your only tool, list the tools again once it runs.

mcpTools.name: save_project
mcpTools.description: Saves everything unsaved in the editors, the user's own work too. Only offered if they allow it in the MCP panel; otherwise ask them to save.

mcpTools.name: begin_edit
mcpTools.description: Starts a group: the edits until end_edit become one entry and one undo_last_edit. Use it for one job made of many edits, like a forest. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools.

title.description: What the job is, like "Forest in Region 001".

mcpTools.name: end_edit
mcpTools.description: Ends the group begun with begin_edit. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools.

mcpTools.name: list_files
mcpTools.description: Files of the open project, with sizes.

filter.description: Only paths containing this text (not case sensitive).

mcpTools.name: read_file
mcpTools.description: A text file of the open project, such as map/war3map.j or map/war3map.w3i.json.

path.description: Project-relative path, as list_files gives it.

offset.description: Start at this character (for files too long for one read).
